mapper.select: select count(*) from r_review where r_no = #{r_no}

select rv.rv_no, rv.rv_point, rv.rv_content, rv.rv_reg_date, rv.r_no, rv.u_no, u.u_name, ri.rvimg_no, ri.rvimg_img from ( select * from ( select rv_no, rv_point, rv_content, rv_reg_date, r_no, u_no from r_review where r_no = #{r_no} order by rv_reg_date desc ) where ROWNUM <= 3 ) rv JOIN users u on rv.u_no = u.u_no LEFT JOIN r_review_img ri on rv.rv_no = ri.rv_no order by rv.rv_reg_date desc, ri.rvimg_no

select rv.rv_no, rv.rv_point, rv.rv_content, rv.rv_reg_date, rv.r_no, rv.u_no, u.u_name, ri.rvimg_no, ri.rvimg_img from r_review rv JOIN users u on rv.u_no = u.u_no LEFT JOIN r_review_img ri on rv.rv_no = ri.rv_no where rv.r_no = #{r_no} order by rv.rv_reg_date desc, ri.rvimg_no
mapper.insert:
select r_review_seq.NEXTVAL from dual
insert into r_review(rv_no,rv_point,rv_content,rv_reg_date,r_no,u_no) values(#{rv_no},#{rv_point},#{rv_content},SYSDATE,#{r_no},#{u_no})
mapper.update: update r_rivew set rv_point=#{rv_point},rv_content=#{rv_content} where rv_no=#{rv_no} and u_no=#{u_no}
mapper.delete: delete from r_review where rv_no = #{rv_no} and u_no = #{u_no}
